==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Known for his aggressive {{ci|Lucian}}.
* Is often affectionately referred to as ZeitGOD.
* Doesn't smile often.
* Is considered one of Turkey's best AD carries of all time.
* Nicknamed ''Baba'' (Father) by fans.
* He is a [https://www.chess.com/member/tarumaredici chess player].
* His ID '''Zeitnot''' is [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/zeitnot a chess term], meaning a situation in which the player has little time to complete their moves.
